Name: Simple Electricity Bill
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]A simple mod created for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/alextofu/mods?gameId=1303]alextofu[/url], this adds a weekly or monthly electricity bill for extra challenge. The bill will arrive either on each Sunday morning or on the 28th, depending on your settings, and is calculated based on your farmhouse level and the number of farm buildings you've constructed, scaling by default with the amount of money earnt.

Requires Content Patcher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url].

If you don't have enough money to pay your bill, it'll take whatever you have remaining but otherwise won't have any negative effect and you won't go into debt. It also won't bill you if you install the mod for the first time on a Sunday, but will start billing you appropriately after that.

[/size][b][size=4]Configuration[/size][size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3]
Simple Electricity Bill has four options so that you can configure it to match your own challenge level:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Weekly or Monthly Bills:[/b] Select whether you'll be billed each week or each month.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Scaled or Static Bills: [/b]Select whether bills will scale with the total amount of money earnt or stay as a static fixed rate. With the "Scaled" option, your bill will increase each time you receive the next level of money-based achievement (Greenhorn, Cowpoke, Homesteader, etc), while the "Static100", "Static200", etc options will multiply the bill by the number in the option.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Multiplayer Division[/b][b]:[/b] Select the number of players for a multiplayer game if you would like bills to be split across players. If using the shared wallet setting or playing in singleplayer, leave this at 1. You can also use this setting to reduce the bill amount if you find the default too challenging.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Additional Multiplier: [/b]Select if you would like an additional multiplier for extra challenge. This will multiply the entire bill amount by the number selected.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Compatibility
[/size][/b][size=3]Simple Electricity is untested with mods that add new custom buildings or with buildings built in locations other than the farm, but its formula should account for both.

For an alternate take on the same idea, check out Kath's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29332]Department of Energy and Water Bills[/url]!

[/size][size=4][b]I will not make changes to how this mod works or add additional factors. This is partly for technical reasons and partly because I am content with the mod as it is. Requests for changes (including balance changes) or additional features will be ignored or deleted.
[/b][/size]
